manifest_row.title: Gloom in the valley as Hazelwood fades to black

screening.climate_relevance: The article connects Hazelwood's closure to the urgency of climate change and moving away from coal, discusses the role of coal in energy policy and the transition to renewables, and includes local views supporting or resisting that transition.
screening.reason: Although much of the article focuses on workers and the local economy, climate change and the shift away from coal are substantial parts of its account of why Hazelwood is closing and what should replace it.
